build_BasicBlock: build a BasicBlock residual block with configurable relu type for a ResNet model
build_ResNet: build a ResNet feature extractor with configurable layers relu type and gamma zero initialization
build_ResEncoder: build a ResEncoder with 3D frontend and 2D ResNet trunk for audiovisual feature extraction
create_conv3x3: create a 3x3 convolutional layer with specified input and output planes and stride
create_downsample_block: create a downsample block using either basic conv or avg pool strategy for ResNet
